req.title: Task id is auto-generated
req.statement: The system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task; client-supplied ids in the payload shall be ignored.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-030 requires that (1) every POST /tasks/ response carries an auto-generated integer id, (2) two successive creates receive distinct ids, and (3) any id supplied by the client in the request body is silently ignored and overwritten by the server-assigned id. The test suite covers: EP-positive (normal create returns integer id), NEG (client-supplied id is ignored, not echoed), BVA (two consecutive tasks get strictly different, monotonically increasing integer ids), DT (payload with and without optional fields both yield valid integer ids), and STC (id field is present and is an int, not None/null). Assertions are exact-value checks to maximise mutation kill rate: status code == 201, id type is int, id != client-supplied value, second id > first id, response keys present with correct types.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_returns_auto_generated_integer_id():
    payload = {"title": "Auto ID Task", "description": "desc", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["id"] > 0
    assert body["title"] == "Auto ID Task"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "created_at" in body

preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
expected: Second id is strictly greater than first id (id2 > id1)

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_consecutive_tasks_receive_distinct_increasing_ids():
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "First Task", "completed": False})
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Second Task", "completed": False})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
    assert isinstance(id1, int)
    assert isinstance(id2, int)
    assert id1 > 0
    assert id2 > 0
    assert id1 != id2
    assert id2 > id1
    assert id2 == id1 + 1

preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Retrieve the created task by the server-assigned id
expected: GET /tasks/999999999 returns 404 (that id was never stored)
trace: R-TASK-030: client-supplied ids in the payload shall be ignored
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_large_client_supplied_id_is_ignored_and_server_assigns_own():
    payload = {"title": "Big ID Task", "completed": False, "id": 999999999}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    server_id = body["id"]
    assert isinstance(server_id, int)
    assert server_id != 999999999
    r2 = client.get(f"/tasks/{server_id}")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.json()["id"] == server_id
    r3 = client.get("/tasks/999999999")
    assert r3.status_code == 404
